title: Decay of the 3-D Taylor-Green vortex against the exact time-Taylor series
observable: Q1 energy decay ratio E(T)/E(0), Q2 enstrophy ratio Omega(T)/Omega(0) at T = 1 eddy time, Q3 velocity L2 field error, Q4 vorticity L2 field error -- all at fixed Re = A*N/nu = 160

primary_reference.definition: u(x,t) = sum_n t^n u^(n)(x) with u^(n+1) = ( nu*Lap u^(n) - P sum_{j=0..n} (u^(j).grad)u^(n-j) ) / (n+1), P = Helmholtz projection; every u^(n) is a finite Fourier series on integer wavevectors, so the recursion is evaluated with exact spectral derivatives and no time discretisation
cite: Taylor G.I., Green A.E., Proc. R. Soc. A 158(895):499-512 (1937), doi:10.1098/rspa.1937.0150 -- the initial field
Morf R.H., Orszag S.A., Frisch U., Phys. Rev. A 21(1):258 (1980), doi:10.1103/PhysRevA.21.258 -- time-Taylor-series construction of the inviscid problem
Brachet M.E. et al., J. Fluid Mech. 130:411-452 (1983), doi:10.1017/S0022112083001148 -- the series as a verification reference for 3-D Taylor-Green
acquisition_log: the reference is a recursion, not a table: no digitisation and no hand-copying is possible by construction

why the classic (z-dependent) field and not the z-invariant one: the z-invariant mode has the closed form u = u0 exp(-nu|k|^2 t) (that is what benchmarks/case_taylor_green_3d checks), but it never produces w != 0 or vortex stretching, so it does not exercise the 3-D convective term

the series generator is itself pinned against two independent closed forms before it is used as a reference: see Q0 in THRESHOLDS -- applied to the z-invariant mode and to the Beltrami (ABC) flow it must reproduce exp(-nu|k|^2 t) decay ratios to 1e-9
series truncation and dealiasing are bounded and reported per run (artifacts/summary.json -> legs.exactness)

adopted_numeric_reference.note: every reference number in the tables is computed by TG3DSeries inside the run; nothing is typed from a paper
adopted_numeric_reference.tolerance_source: feature_ledger CASE-TAYLOR-GREEN-3D acceptance: ref = 级数精确解, band < 8%

validity_window.why: the Taylor series converges inside a finite radius; the run is held to T <= 1.25 eddy times and the retained-order tail is written out so a reader can see the truncation level

adopted_numeric_reference.field_reference_note: field-side quantities (Q3, Q4) use velocity_field(band_limit=True) on a work grid nfft = max(default_nfft(order), 3N): the series' 2/3-dealiasing band then covers the evaluation band.  The legacy order-clamping path makes the returned field depend on the work grid by up to 11% at N=32 (recorded in artifacts as legs.reference_convergence.field_workgrid.default_nfft_level); it is not used for any gate.

cross_checks.quantity: energy / enstrophy histories (and the band-limited velocity field)
cross_checks.source: spectral_dns_reference (src/tensorlbm/tg3d_series.py): de-aliased Fourier pseudo-spectral DNS, integrating-factor RK4, same IC, same box, same nu -- a different code path from the series
cross_checks.role: guards against a mistake in the series recursion (the closed forms used by Q0 are nonlinearly trivial and cannot test the convective term)
cross_checks.enforced_by: leg `dns` -> Q10_series_vs_dns_rel (le 1e-3); DNS time step refined 1 vs 1/2 so the residual is attributed, not asserted

cross_checks.source: closed form for the z-invariant Taylor-Green mode (exponential decay, machine-checked exact NS solution)
cross_checks.role: the zero-nonlinearity limit the series must reproduce exactly

cross_checks.quantity: reference velocity field on the N^3 lattice
cross_checks.source: the same series, evaluated band-limited (velocity_field(band_limit=True)) on working grids nfft >= 3N and 3.5N
cross_checks.role: bounds the reference's own field-level error, which the modal sums (Q5, Q9) cannot see

predeclared_rejection_of_alternatives.z_invariant_mode_as_primary: rejected as primary for the 3-D point: no w, no vortex stretching; kept as the Q0 anchor instead
predeclared_rejection_of_alternatives.another_LBM_as_reference: rejected: self-reference is not a benchmark
predeclared_rejection_of_alternatives.single_grid_point: rejected: a pass at one N cannot be told apart from a fortuitous error cancellation, so a fixed-Re grid ladder with an observed-order estimate is part of the case
